questions.question: What does indifference curve represent?
questions.solution:
• The indifference curve represents the sets of good with different quantities to which the consumer is indifferent.
 
• The sets represent satisfaction that consumer derived from the two goods.

questions.question: India has taken the concept of 'Judicial Review' from which country's constitution?
questions.solution: Judicial Review is the capacity of the judiciary to check the constitutional validity of any law, order or rule of the government. India has taken this concept from USA which was based on the famous case of Marbury v Madison.

questions.question: How many times a person can be elected as the President of India?
questions.solution:
• There is no bar on a number of times for which a person can become President of India.
 
• However, as per Article 58 of the Constitution, he/she must be an Indian citizen of 35 years or above and eligible to become a member of Lok Sabha.

questions.question: Which of the following is the largest gland in human body?
questions.solution:
• The liver helps in digestion by secreting bile juice mainly along with making proteins and metabolizing drugs.
 
• It is the largest gland in the human body.

questions.question: On which principle does the hydraulic lift works?
questions.solution:
• Hydraulic lift works on the principle of **Pascal's law**.
 
• Pascal's law states that a pressure change occurring anywhere in a confined incompressible fluid is transmitted throughout the fluid such that the same change occurs everywhere.
 
• This law is used in hydraulic lifts and hydraulic brakes in cars.
 
• Archimedes Principle: When a solid body is partially are completely immersed in a fluid, the fluid exerts an upward force on the body, whose magnitude is equal to the weight of the displaced fluid.

questions.question: At what temperature (in degree celsius), the numerical values on Celsius and Fahrenheit scales become equal?
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• Temperature: It is the measure of the degree of hotness and coldness of a body.

 
 
• The SI unit of temperature is Kelvin (K).
 
 
 
• Fahrenheit and Celsius are measurements of temperature and are related to each other as follows:

⇒ C = (F - 32) × (5)/(9)

Where C is the temperature in Celsius and F is the temperature in Fahrenheit.

EXPLAN**ATION**__**:**

 
• Since we need temperature in fahrenheit and celsius to be equal:

Now, let C = F = x

So,

⇒ x = (x - 32) × (5)/(9)

or, 9x = 5x – 160

or, 4x = -160

or, x = -40

Therefore, -40°C = -40°F

questions.question: In MICR, what does 'I' stands for?
questions.solution: MICR (magnetic ink character recognition) is a technology used to verify the legitimacy or originality of paper documents, especially bank cheques. It uses a special ink that is read by the computers.

questions.question: What is the process of conversion of solid state directly to gaseous state called?

questions.question: Which of the following causes fly ash?
questions.solution:
• *Fly ash* is a *coal* combustion product that is composed of the particulates that are driven out of *coal*-fired boilers together with the flue gases.
 
• It causes respiratory and skin diseases.

questions.question: "Dulari Kanya", a scheme to bring down infant mortality in the state is launched by which Indian State?
questions.solution: The Arunachal Pradesh government has launched a special scheme “*DulariKanya*” to check infant mortality in the state on 26th January, 2017. Under this scheme, state government will deposit Rs. 20,000 in the bank account of a girl child born in any government hospital.
